text:
sara: quick huddle re: policy editor UX. put a lightweight prototype here: https://figma.com/file/xYz. two open questions: 1) card reordering behavior (grid-slot snap vs free-drag), 2) how the preview sim should surface perf cost info without overwhelming the canvas.

toni: nice work. leaning toward slot snap. makes mental model clearer: rule positions === priority slots. free-drag feels like it implies continuous weight, which we don't support.

praveen: slot snap is friendlier for keyboard/assistive tech. Keyboard flow: focus card, press Cmd/Ctrl+Alt+Arrow to move between slots. announce with live region: "Moved rule to slot 2".

ben: agree. a UX tradeoff: slot snapping can cause cards to shift abruptly. suggestion: animate translate + scale down the source card slightly while dragging to reduce perceived jump. Also add a subtle dashed placeholder.

sara: good call. what about validation? currently we show a top banner for conflicts. I think rule-level inline indicators are better but must avoid layout thrash during drag.

toni: inline indicator as a compact chip on the right: red dot + short message on hover/expand. on focus it expands to full text. example copy: "Conflict: matches same request as Rule 1" instead of generic "Rule blocked".

praveen: for screen readers, expose the full message via aria-describedby linked to the card, but hide the visual expansion from assistive tech (use aria-hidden on the visual chip). Also ensure the chip uses contrast >=4.5:1.

design-lint-bot: a11y report: .chip-error text/foreground ratio 3.6:1. Recommend using #7A0018 or bold 600 weight to meet 4.5:1.

ben: preview simulation UX idea: small toggle in top-right: "simulate traffic split" opens a slider (0-100%) and a dropdown for scenario: "all traffic / sample 10% / custom". overlay shows two thin lines on timeline: median latency and p95 cost. keep overlay off by default.

sara: product request: show per-rule perf delta when sim enabled (hover rule -> +3ms / +$0.002). but need to be careful with noise. maybe collapse deltas behind a chevron.

toni: UX nit: empty state when zero rules should teach evaluation order: "Top → Bottom. Use priority to short-circuit routing." CTA: primary "Add rule" plus secondary "Import from template". include keyboard hint: `r` to add.

praveen: reorder telemetry: track reorder_source, reorder_target, interaction_type (drag|keyboard). We'll need these to tune snap thresholds.

sara: action list: 1) studio: update comps with slot snapping + animated placeholder (toni), 2) implement compact inline chip that expands on focus and wire aria-describedby (praveen), 3) lower-contrast error colors updated per lint (ben), 4) preview sim control + per-rule delta affordance (sara), 5) add telemetry events for reorder (praveen). timeframe: comps by EOD, eng sync tomorrow.

ben: will prototype micro-animations in the playground and share CSS snippet:
```css
.card--dragging { transform: translateY(4px) scale(0.995); transition: transform 120ms ease; }
.placeholder { border: 1px dashed var(--muted); opacity: 0.9; }
```

toni: will annotate keyboard flows and add accessible labels.

sara: thanks folks. cc @eng-frontend. :sparkles:
